title: Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Magic
intro: [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Grab your wands, your lamps and your fairy godmothers, because today is ALL about magic and spells. [mischievously] If you get one wrong... I might just turn you into a frog.

art.prompt: A whimsical twilight castle courtyard bursting with magic: a glowing pumpkin coach, swirling streams of sparkling fairy dust, floating spell books, a crystal ball and a bubbling cauldron, starry violet and gold sky, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Boo
categories.intro: [excited] Salagadoola mechicka boola! Our film category is the most magical makeover in movie history. It's Cinderella!

art.prompt: A giant golden pumpkin transforming into an ornate glass-and-gold carriage in a moonlit garden, sparkles swirling, a single glass slipper resting on palace steps, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Fairy Godmother turns this vegetable into a shining coach.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a pumpkin! [laughs] Best use of a pumpkin until pie was invented.

clues.clue: The Fairy Godmother warns that her spell will break at the stroke of this hour.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is midnight! Bong, bong, bong... and suddenly you're running down the stairs with ONE shoe.

clues.clue: For the ball, Cinderella's horse, Major, is magically transformed into this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the coachman! Bruno the dog gets to be the footman. [chuckles] Talk about a career change for one night.

clues.clue: Cinderella's stepsisters are Anastasia and this sister.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Drizella! [sarcastic] And what a lovely singing voice she has. Sing sweet nightingale... NOPE.

clues.clue: He's the King's right-hand man who travels the kingdom trying the glass slipper on every maiden.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Grand Duke! [dramatic pause] He's also the guy who dropped the slipper and shattered it. Thank goodness Cinderella kept a spare.

categories.title: Spellbound
categories.intro: Next up, Spellbound! [mischievously] Every clue is about a spell, a curse or a wish. Try not to get turned into a toad.

art.prompt: An ancient spell book lying open on a stone table, glowing runes rising off the pages in green and blue smoke, a seashell necklace, a gilded oil lamp and an enchanted rose nearby, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Ursula's spell takes Ariel's voice in exchange for a pair of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is legs! Then she can't talk to the prince. [sighs] Classic Ursula fine print. Always read the contract.

clues.clue: The Genie in Aladdin grants his master this many wishes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is three! [whispers] And no wishing for more wishes. Those are the rules.

clues.clue: In Fantasia, Mickey enchants this household item to carry buckets of water for him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a broom! [laughs] Then he chops it up and gets a whole army of brooms. That's what we call a chore disaster.

clues.clue: The sorcerer in The Sorcerer's Apprentice has a name that is Disney spelled backward.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yen Sid! Spell it backward and you get Disney. [chuckles] Walt was sneaky like that.

clues.clue: In Brave, Merida must mend the bond torn by pride before this moment, or her mother stays a bear forever.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the second sunrise! [excited] Fate be changed, look inside! A little sewing, a lot of hugging, and Queen Elinor is back.

categories.title: Magical Wardrobes
categories.intro: It's our media category, Magical Wardrobes! I'll show you the colours of a spellcaster's outfit. You name the character. [mischievously] Some of them are good... and some, not so much.

art.prompt: An enchanted sorcerer's dressing room: star-covered robes, a pointed wizard hat, an icy blue gown on a dress form and flowing capes floating on their own in swirling magic light, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Icy blue gown, a sparkling cape and a platinum braid. She's got powers she can't hide.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elsa! [laughs] Made that dress herself, out of ICE, in about thirty seconds. Fashion designers hate her.

clues.clue: A deep purple gown, a towering lilac headdress, grey skin and a whole secret lab full of potions.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yzma! [laughs] Pull the lever, Kronk! WRONG LEVERRR! Scary beyond all reason, and also fabulous.

clues.clue: A black robe with purple lining, pale green skin and a pair of horns. She curses at christenings.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maleficent! [dramatic pause] She didn't get an invitation. And honestly... that's on the King and Queen.

clues.clue: A bright red robe and a tall blue hat covered in stars and moons. He's an apprentice with ambition.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sorcerer Mickey! [chuckles] Yen Sid's hat looked way better on Yen Sid. Just saying.

clues.clue: A white blouse with colourful embroidery, a teal skirt and round green glasses. Her whole family has magic.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mirabel Madrigal! [excited] No gift? No problem. She ends up being the MOST magical one in the Casita.

categories.title: Enchanted Attractions
categories.intro: Our Parks category is a picture round! I'll show you a scene from a spellbinding Disney park attraction. [whispers] You name it.

art.prompt: A fairy-tale theme park at dusk seen from above: glowing castle spires, a spinning flying-carpet ride, a pirate galleon floating in the night sky and fireworks bursting overhead, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Name this spinning Adventureland ride at Magic Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Magic Carpets of Aladdin! [laughs] Watch out for the spitting camel. He has excellent aim.

media.prompt: Sunny Arabian bazaar courtyard with a ring of colorful flying-carpet ride vehicles circling a giant golden oil lamp on a pedestal, palm trees, striped awnings and brass lanterns, a stone camel statue in the background, theme park ride photo, no people, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Name this Fantasyland dark ride where you sail through the sky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter Pan's Flight! [excited] Think happy thoughts! The line is long, but flying over London is worth it.

media.prompt: Small wooden pirate-galleon ride vehicle hanging from an overhead track, flying through a starry night sky above a glowing miniature model of Victorian London with a clock tower, a bridge and the winding river below, sparkling golden dust trailing behind, no people, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Name this classic Adventureland show where the birds and flowers sing.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Enchanted Tiki Room! [singing] In the tiki tiki tiki tiki tiki room! [laughs] Sorry, it's stuck in my head now, and yours too.

media.prompt: Interior of a thatched Polynesian show room, carved wooden tiki poles, bright tropical parrots perched on hanging perches, a central fountain of tropical flowers, warm torch light and colorful lanterns, theme park photo, no people, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Guests can tiptoe past this sleeping creature in a lair beneath the castle. Which Disney park is it in?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland Paris! [whispers] It's called La Taniere du Dragon. [gasps] And yes, it opens its eyes and roars. Tread lightly!

media.prompt: Enormous sleeping dragon with emerald and violet scales, chained in a misty underground stone cavern lit by flickering green light, shallow pools of water, carved gothic arches overhead, dramatic theme park dungeon atmosphere, no people, no text, no logos

clues.clue: This enchanted object waits in Fantasyland for a worthy kid to pull it free. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Sword in the Stone! [chuckles] Whoever pulls it out becomes king. I've tried. Many times. Still not king.

media.prompt: Medieval sword with a golden hilt plunged into an iron anvil set on a mossy stone block, glowing beam of sunlight from above, a colorful carousel with golden poles blurred in the background of a fairy-tale village plaza, no people, no text, no logos

categories.title: Enchanted Objects
categories.intro: And the fan category is Enchanted Objects! I'll describe a magical item from a Disney film. [mischievously] You tell me what it is. No peeking in the crystal ball.

art.prompt: A cluttered wizard's shelf of magical objects: a golden lamp, an ornate hand mirror, a glowing golden flower, a lit candle in a window and a spiral green stone, all softly glowing, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Genie lives inside this golden object until someone rubs it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a lamp! [laughs] Phenomenal cosmic powers... itty bitty living space.

clues.clue: The Evil Queen asks this, on the wall, who's the fairest one of all.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Magic Mirror! [sighs] Brutally honest. Every single time. I would NOT want that in my bathroom.

clues.clue: In Tangled, Rapunzel's magic hair comes from a single drop of sunlight that grew into this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a golden flower! Flower, gleam and glow... [whispers] and maybe don't let Gothel find it.

clues.clue: In Encanto, the Madrigal family's gifts come from this magical item that never burns out.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a candle! It sits in the window of Casita. [laughs] Imagine the electric bill if it was a lightbulb.

clues.clue: In Moana, the heart of Te Fiti is a small spiral of this kind of stone.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is greenstone, also called pounamu! [excited] Treasured in Maori culture, and apparently VERY easy to lose to a crab.
